title: Why A4 almost keeps its shape when cut in half
description:
An everyday rectangle has a hidden rule. In the ideal A-series system, a rotated half keeps the same proportions: 1:√2. Each length becomes about 70.7% of the original; the area halves. Real paper sizes are rounded to whole millimetres.

Save this for the next time you resize a design.
Original explanatory animation with synthetic narration. Sources: Cambridge NRICH, “Fit for Photocopying”; DIN, “Herzlichen Glückwunsch A4!”
